note: Pairs like [a, b] are the value on level 1 and the value on level 20; the game blends between them.

hoser.name: The Hoser
hoser.crime: Blasts dogs with the garden hose for a laugh.
hoser.tip: Wait for the jet to swing away, then run up the edge and CHOMP.

snatcher.name: The Snatcher
snatcher.crime: A crooked dogcatcher who nets every dog he sees.
snatcher.tip: Bait his swing, back off, then CHOMP while he untangles. Zoomies tear right through the net.

chainer.name: The Chainer
chainer.crime: Keeps his dog chained outside day and night.
chainer.tip: His chain blocks the road. CHOMP him and it drops for everybody.

yeller.name: The Yeller
yeller.crime: Screams at dogs through a megaphone.
yeller.tip: Rush in right after a yell passes. Zoomies can't hear a thing.

boomer.name: The Boomer
boomer.crime: Throws firecrackers at dogs to scare them.
boomer.tip: A red circle means BOOM. Get out of it, then go get him.

drench.name: Drench Dan
drench.title: King of the garden hose
drench.tip: His sprinkler arms spin. Slip between the jets and CHOMP. Three bites and the gate opens.

captain.name: Captain Snatch
captain.title: Boss of the crooked pound
captain.tip: Giant net, short temper. Make him miss, then CHOMP. Three bites.

bruno.name: Boom-Boom Bruno
bruno.title: Firecracker kingpin
bruno.tip: Three firecrackers at a time. Dance through the circles and CHOMP. Three bites.

ringleader.name: The Ringleader
ringleader.title: Runs the whole rotten operation
ringleader.tip: He yells, he throws firecrackers, he swings a net. Five bites and every pup goes free.
